facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; Canada has had no exchange controls since 1951.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: banks like RBC and TD offer personal US-dollar accounts.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: A sole proprietor needs a CRA Business Number only for GST/HST.
facts.L2_tax_id: Canada issues tax numbers to residents; which one freelancers use isn't confirmed yet.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed at 14–33% federally, plus provincial tax.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 5% GST; register above CAD 30,000 a year, foreign sales included.
facts.L5_data_protection: PIPEDA applies to businesses handling personal information.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online consumer protection laws exist; specific refund rules not confirmed yet.
facts.D1_id_document: Driver's licence, provincial photo ID or passport.

watch_out.text: Foreign clients' payments count toward the CAD 30,000 GST threshold.
